envelope.description: The design.story and plan first prompts and the synthesize requirement

body.title: The design.story and plan first prompts and the synthesize requirement
body.summary: Render the digest above the Story detail or the LLD handoff and make EPIC_IMPACT_FIRST_ACTION the first action in design.story's and plan's context.assemble prompts (src/workflow/runners/design-story/index.ts, src/workflow/runners/plan/index.ts); a first or standalone Story gets only the one-line 'does not apply'; at synthesize design.story and plan reject a later Story's LLD or PLAN without a non-empty analysis (applies:true, findings, at least one source) and carry epicImpact verbatim from the first step into the LLD and the PLAN. Refresh inventory fixtures only for what this task changes. Tests in epic-impact-prompts.test.ts and the synthesize check in epic-impact-artifacts.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: the design.story and plan context.assemble prompts for a later Story lead with EPIC_IMPACT_FIRST_ACTION and carry the rendered digest above the Story detail or the LLD handoff, and the prompts for a first or standalone Story carry only the one-line 'does not apply'
a synthesize with a non-null digest and no analysis, or an empty one, is rejected with the reason, and one with an analysis carries it into the LLD and the PLAN
the existing prompt and synthesize tests still pass and no inventory test case fails beyond the four that already fail on a clean checkout

tests.name: epic-impact-prompts.test.ts: the design.story and plan context.assemble prompts for a later Story of an Epic lead with EPIC_IMPACT_FIRST_ACTION and carry the rendered digest above the Story detail or the LLD handoff, and the prompts for a first or standalone Story carry only the one-line 'does not apply'

epic-impact-artifacts.test.ts: an LLD and a PLAN with an epicImpact render an 'Epic impact analysis' section, one without it renders exactly as before, and a synthesize with a non-null digest and no analysis (or an empty one) is rejected with the reason
